Round-and-Round Sushi! Here's how the versus game works!{KP}Grab sushi off the moving belt with the Circle button!{KP}Once you've grabbed some sushi, press the Circle button again!{KP}You'll eat the sushi!{KP}Whoever scores more points eating sushi in 60 seconds wins!{KP}Now, aim for a high score and do your best!{KP}1P is Momotaro-san, and 2P is Kintaro-san!
